what: Per-module ingestion list omits astroid module construction before SimilaritiesChecker.process_module
scenario_or_breakage: Pylint 4 SimilaritiesChecker.process_module takes an astroid nodes.Module and reads node.stream(); tokenize plus process_tokens alone do not produce that node. A literal implementation can call process_module with the wrong type, skip file_state wiring, or diverge from cd python && pylint . discovery.
suggested_fix: Add an explicit astroid parse step between process_tokens and process_module (or delegate ingestion to pylint's per-file check path with only similarities enabled) and test that process_module receives a real Module for each discovered file.
